title: Next year’s Nguyên tiêu date is not posted
summary: Hoi An’s 2026 Nguyên tiêu plan covered 26 February to 4 March, including incense at Chùa Ông. That window has passed. The next civil dates, and any ticket waiver, are check on arrival.
when: The 16th of the first lunar month. The next civil date is check on arrival.
photoAlt: The gate of Phuc Kien assembly hall in Hoi An
body: Nguyên tiêu in Hoi An is the 16th of the first lunar month, centered on Chùa Ông at 24 Trần Phú. The conservation centre’s plan for Xuân Bính Ngọ 2026 turned that into civil dates: 26 February through 4 March, the 10th through the 16th. In that plan, Chùa Ông and Chùa Bà were open for incense on 3 and 4 March, including from 03:00 on the 4th, and sightseeing tickets were not sold for a named list of halls.

Those days are over. The plan does not carry the waiver, the 03:00 opening, or the civil dates into another year. The lunar night stays the 16th. The next civil date is check on arrival. The photograph is the Phuc Kien assembly hall in the ancient town, not the gate of Chùa Ông.

sources.label: Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre, Tết Nguyên tiêu 2026 plan
